messages:
elaine: quick note: running an A/B promote of v4alpha (fp16 -> int4 hybrid) at 10% traffic. early signals show a decent latency win overall but a concerning quality dip on very long contexts (>3000 tokens). opening thread to decide rollout gates / auto-fallback params.
omar: numbers? slice size, metric deltas, p-values?
elaine: summary: long-context slice (>=3000 tokens) n=3.1k, MRR -2.3% vs baseline, F1 (QA benchmarks) -1.8, hallucination classifier +0.7%. global traffic n=80k, global MRR -0.2%. p95 latency: global -18ms, long-context p95 +92ms.
vijay: small n but consistent direction. For auto-fallback we should combine absolute and slice-protected rules. Proposal: global auto-fallback if (global MRR drop >= 1.2% AND sustained 20m AND samples>=10k) OR (any protected slice meets its slice-specific rule).
elaine: define protected slices: legal, finance, compliance. For those, require immediate rollback if hallucination delta >= 0.5% OR MRR drop >= 0.9% for 5m.
omar: add significance guard: require delta > 1.6 * stderr OR p<0.05. also add a hysteresis window to avoid flip-flopping: require condition true in 2 consecutive 5m windows before auto-rollback unless immediate flag for protected slices.
vijay: latency guard too: if p95 increases > 85ms for 10m -> fallback (but don't count transient GC spikes).
elaine: ci-bot shows canary id cnr-17405-4alpha started at 1740501200 routing=10%. smoke tests 92/95, failing 3 overlap long-context prompts.
ci-bot: canary cnr-17405-4alpha deployed at 1740501222. smoke: fail=3. perf: global p95 -18ms, long-context p95 +92ms.
omar: can we shadow-run the int4 variant for another 12h to gather more long-context samples without increasing user-facing routing?
elaine: yes. push shadow for 12h and keep A/B at 10% for now but pause further promotion.
vijay: config snippet I'll drop for ops (small JSON blob):

```json
{"rollout_policy":"hybrid","auto_fallback":{ "global":{"mrr_drop_pct":1.2,"persistence_mins":20,"min_samples":10000,"significance_multiplier":1.6,"hysteresis_windows":2}, "protected_slices":{"legal":{"mrr_drop_pct":0.9,"hallucination_pct":0.5,"persistence_mins":5,"immediate":true},"finance":{"mrr_drop_pct":0.9,"hallucination_pct":0.5,"persistence_mins":5,"immediate":true}}, "latency_guard":{"p95_ms":85,"persistence_mins":10}}```

elaine: also adding a watch-only tier: watch if global MRR drop >=0.4% OR hallucination delta >=0.25% on any slice -> pages owner but no auto-rollback.
omar: I'll run a bootstrap on the long-context slice (resample with replacement) and compute stderr and p-values. ETA 18m.
ci-bot: shadow-run enabled for cnr-17405-4alpha for 12h starting 1740504300.
vijay: ops: please wire an incident rule to #incidents for protected-slice immediate triggers. also include a small rake task to export the failing prompts for debugging (redact PII).
elaine: agreed. action items: 1) enable shadow 12h, 2) ops to add protected-slice alerting and rake export, 3) omar runs bootstrap + posts stats, 4) hold any promote beyond 10% until green.
omar: bootstrap results: long-context MRR delta -2.1%, stderr 0.5% -> delta >1.6*stderr and p~0.02. filing auto-rollback per policy if not improving in next 6m.
ci-bot: initiating rollback for canary cnr-17405-4alpha: routing 10% -> 0% starting 1740504680. status: in-progress.
elaine: thanks. follow-up: schedule a focused eval harness for long-context summarization with simulated session-level KV behavior and run int4 quant-aware fine-tune + small distillation to recover fidelity.
